input.quote: (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
input.rationale: Article XIII is one-sided and sits in walk-away territory. The cap in (b) protects only Licensor and is set at one half of amounts paid — far below even 6 months' fees — while Licensee's liability is entirely uncapped and is in fact expanded by the broad Article XII indemnity (p0128–p0129). The exclusion of indirect/consequential damages in (a) also runs only in Licensor's favour and expressly excludes all IP infringement liability. There are no carve-outs at all for confidentiality, data protection, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, so the clause fails the fallback (mutual 12-month cap with carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct). Redline makes the cap mutual at the greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000, adds the standard uncapped Excluded Claims, disapplies (a) to those claims, and confirms Licensee's fee obligations are not capped "damages".

proposal.summary: Make the Article XIII cap mutual at the greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000 and add standard uncapped carve-outs
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We need the liability cap to be mutual and at a meaningful level: today only Licensor is capped (at one half of amounts paid) while our liability is unlimited, which is outside our playbook. We have set a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000, with indemnification, confidentiality/data protection, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sitting outside the cap, and fees payable not treated as capped damages.

ops.oldText: (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
ops.newText: (b) EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, EACH PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (I) THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE BY LICENSEE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (II) USD 1,000,000. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. THE EXCLUSIONS AND LIMITATIONS IN SUBSECTION (a) SHALL NOT APPLY TO EXCLUDED CLAIMS, AND LICENSEE'S OBLIGATION TO PAY FEES DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT BE TREATED AS DAMAGES SUBJECT TO THIS CAP.
